lead.headline: Tuten still in the lineup; Rodriguez held
lead.deck: Start Taylor before Sunday noon. Rodriguez now projects 15.7, but the only seat to drop changed hands on Wednesday.
lead.body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten is ruled out with the ankle and foot, and at 06:50 he was still in your RB slot. Start Jonathan Taylor in his place before 12:00 Sunday: that is 14.0 points. The Rams D/ST add closed WRONG overnight. The Steelers D/ST you dropped scored 24 against the Rams' 10, with two defensive touchdowns in a 27-5 win. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is now a free agent projecting 15.7, which meets the condition Friday's brief set. This brief holds him anyway: it is 1.7 over Taylor, a coin flip, and the only droppable seat is Aaron Jones Sr., added on Wednesday. Likely is cleared and Daniels faces the league's softest pass defence. You trail JuiceJam 36.6 to 65.6.
